disclaimer: DRIFT outputs are model advisories. They are NOT IMD/NDMA warnings. No forecast availability time is recorded, so no operational 2-6 h lead time is claimed.

sources.label: SRTM terrain + gauge hydrology (static)
sources.note: Static geography, not a forecast; hydrology exists for only 75 of 992 cells

terrain.susceptibility_note: flood_susceptibility_dem_proxy is a DERIVED DEM index, not a flood prediction
terrain.hydrology_note: 75/992 cells (7.6%) have real, gauge-derived catchment hydrology. This is inherently sparse -- India has far more than 106 distinct 1deg catchment cells -- and is NOT a claim of pan-India drainage coverage.

thunderstorm.summary: Station model for VOBL (Bengaluru) slot windows is live; pan-India thunderstorm shows NWP instability guidance only (CAPE/CIN). The pan-India thunderstorm model artifact is unavailable or not evaluated, so no pan-India thunderstorm probability is shown.
thunderstorm.target: Thunderstorm at VOBL within a 6-h IST slot (observation label); pan-India: none

metar.raw: METAR VOBG 241600Z 08006KT 6000 FEW008 SCT012 BKN080 21/21 Q1021 NOSIG

station_evidence.model_winds_note: Wind components are the station-model inputs (GFS-derived); wind shear is NOT available pan-India (null in every grid cell).
station_evidence.precipitable_water_note: GFS PRECIP_WATER (model-derived precipitable water, not satellite-observed IWV)

extreme_rainfall.summary: Daily heavy-rain-day score (>= 64.5 mm/24 h proxy) per grid cell from a LODO-validated XGBoost; an uncalibrated ranking score for the whole forecast day. Not a cloudburst, not a 2-6 h forecast.
extreme_rainfall.target: IMD gridded daily rainfall >= 64.5 mm at 0.25 deg

distinctions.what: Daily score from panindia_cb_v1 for the whole forecast day (>= 64.5 mm/24 h).
NWP model precipitation at a single model hour. Guidance, not observed.

Very intense, short-duration, highly localised rainfall (commonly quoted as >= 100 mm/h over ~20-30 km2). DRIFT has no verified cloudburst labels and no sub-hourly rainfall input, so it does NOT predict cloudbursts.

flash_flood.summary: No validated flash-flood model. A PU-learning ranking exists for research only and is not a probability.
missing_for_live: per-cell catchment hydrology (only 75 of 992 cells have gauge-derived values)

alerts.withheld_explanation: no approved operational horizon registered for this hazard; inputs were unavailable or a climatology/default fallback was used; no genuine lead-specific prediction; no recorded forecast availability time (never inferred); operational lead is not calculable and strictly positive; no approved alertable prediction semantics for this hazard; VALID_TIME_NOT_IN_FUTURE; value is a heuristic/uncalibrated/research score, not a calibrated probability
